chapter: Television, the stroke and later reflections
title: Tape change and the unions and guilds a performer must join
summary: Side B of Tape 12; he lists AGVA, AFTRA, SAG, Negro Actors Guild and Equity as required for welfare benefits.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: You'd be surprised how many different organizations you have to belong to to get in this business and be on the ground floor. Do you know that? You've got to belong to AGVA, AFTRA, SAG, NAG and Equity. American Guild of Variety Artists, American Federation for Theater and Radio, Negro Actors Guild, Actors Equity -- all these things you have to belong to in order to get a welfare contingent out of this situation.
